purpose: Validate AXM material donor-pack v0.2 entries and adapt only explicit material routing hints and declared families into the existing Asset Atom texture/material grammar without inventing visual semantics.

properties.donor_pack: one axm-material-donor-pack/v0.2 object carrying portable reusable material entries and optional declared families
properties.strict: optional boolean; when true, any held entry or family fails the complete adaptation instead of returning a partial exact result

contains: exact donor source identity and version receipt
SHA-256 evidence over decoded donor payload bytes
truth boundary separating descriptor compatibility from rendering or physical-material correctness

relationships: provides the first explicit downstream consumer for AXM Material / Surface Fabric donor packs
maps donor entries to Asset Atom texture descriptors only when the source pack already declares a supported channel hint
maps a declared donor family to one material atom only when its accepted members resolve to unique supported texture channels
keeps held donor state visible instead of guessing missing material semantics or silently discarding unmappable entries

anatomy_refs.basis: Portable donor image payloads become bounded texture-resource descriptors with explicit channel and SHA-256 evidence.
Declared material families become exact Asset Atom material graphs only when each accepted member maps to one unique explicit texture channel.

limitations: only axm-material-donor-pack v0.2 is accepted directly; an older pack must first be imported and re-exported by a compatible Material / Surface Fabric version
unassigned channel hints are held rather than inferred from pixels, names, or appearance
data URLs are decoded and SHA-256 hashed, but donor:// resource descriptors are not installed, rendered, sampled, or compared perceptually by this capability
family adaptation requires one unique supported channel per accepted member; duplicate channels or held members keep that family on HOLD
Asset Atom validation proves descriptor structure and dependency integrity, not PBR correctness, artistic quality, renderer compatibility, or physical-material behavior

truth.basis: The adapter distinguishes donor declarations, decoded-byte evidence, exact Asset Atom validation, held state, and unverified rendering/material claims.

agency.basis: Material routing enters only through explicit donor-pack channel hints and family declarations; strict versus partial handling is caller-selected.

continuity.basis: Stable donor entry IDs, source evidence, SHA-256 byte receipts, and family membership are retained in the adaptation receipt instead of flattened away.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Unsupported, ambiguous, unassigned, undecodable, MIME-conflicting, or duplicate-channel state holds before semantic or rendering claims are made.
